_comment: Consumer-side fixture for the crucible-evaluator -> crucible-dashboard contract on report_card['attestation'] (config-I6974). Shape mirrors crucible-evaluator grading/attestation.py::build_run_attestation exactly: schema/run_date/verdict/evaluator/backtester/reason, with each half carrying its own status/verdict/checks/n_checks/n_failed/n_errored/engine. Per-check bodies are truncated to one record per half - the renderer reads counts and reasons, never individual checks, and pinning all six would make the fixture drift on every battery edit without testing anything more.
